sentences.en: Good morning and thank you for coming here today.I'd like to bring you up to date with changes in the school that will affect your children.
sentences.zh: 早上好，感谢各位今天前来。我想向各位通报一下将影响你们孩子的学校近期变化。

sentences.en: As you know, the school buildings date from various times: some from the 1970s, some from the last five years, and of course Dartfield House is over a century old.
sentences.zh: 如各位所知，学校建筑年代不一：有些建于20世纪70年代，有些建于最近五年，而达特菲尔德大厦则已有百余年历史。

sentences.en: It was commissioned by a businessman, Neville Richards, and intended as his family home, but he died before it was completed.
sentences.zh: 它由商人内维尔·理查兹出资兴建，原计划作为其家族住宅，但他却在竣工前去世。

sentences.en: His heir chose to sell it to the local council, who turned it into offices.
sentences.zh: 他的继承人选择将大厦出售给当地议会，后者将其改作办公场所。

sentences.en: A later plan to convert it into a tourist information centre didn't come about, through lack of money, and instead it formed the nucleus of this school when it opened 40 years ago.
sentences.zh: 后来曾计划将其改建为旅游信息中心，但因资金不足而未能实现；相反，它于40年前学校成立时成为本校的核心建筑。

sentences.en: The school has grown as the local population has increased, and I can now give you some news about the lower school site, which is separated from the main site by a road.
sentences.zh: 随着当地人口增长，学校规模也不断扩大；现在我可以向各位介绍有关低年级部校区的最新消息——该校区与主校区之间隔着一条马路。

sentences.en: Planning permission has been granted for development of both sites.
sentences.zh: 两处校区的开发均已获得规划许可。

sentences.en: The lower school will move to new buildings that will be constructed on the main site.
sentences.zh: 低年级部将迁入主校区新建的校舍。

sentences.en: Developers will construct houses on the existing lower school site.
sentences.zh: 开发商将在现有低年级部校区建造住宅。

sentences.en: Work on the new school buildings should start within the next few months.
sentences.zh: 新校舍工程预计将在未来几个月内启动。

sentences.en: A more imminent change concerns the catering facilities and the canteen.
sentences.zh: 另一项更为紧迫的变化涉及餐饮设施及食堂。

sentences.en: The canteen is always very busy throughout the lunch period- in fact it's often full to capacity, because a lot of our pupils like the food that's on offer there.
sentences.zh: 午餐时段食堂始终非常繁忙——事实上常常满员，因为许多学生都喜欢那里提供的食物。

sentences.en: But there's only one serving point, so most pupils have to wait a considerable time to be served.
sentences.zh: 但食堂仅设一个取餐点，因此大多数学生需长时间排队等候。

sentences.en: This is obviously unsatisfactory，as they may have hardly finished their lunch before afternoon lessons start.
sentences.zh: 这显然不尽如人意，因为他们可能刚吃完午餐，下午课程便已开始。

sentences.en: So we've had a new Food Hall built, and this will come into use next week.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们新建了一座美食厅，下周起正式启用。

sentences.en: It'll have several serving areas, and 111 give you more details about those in a minute, but one thing we ask you to do, to help in the smooth running of the Food Hall, is to discuss with your children each morning which type of food they want to eat that day, so they can go straight to the relevant serving point.
sentences.zh: 美食厅将设有多个取餐区；稍后我将详细介绍各取餐区，但在此我们恳请各位每天早晨与孩子沟通，确定当天想吃的餐食类型，以便他们能直接前往相应取餐点。

sentences.en: There won't be any junk food- everything on offer will be healthy- and there's no change to the current system of paying for lunches by topping up your child's electronic payment card online.
sentences.zh: 美食厅不提供任何垃圾食品——所有餐食均健康营养；目前通过在线为孩子的电子支付卡充值来支付午餐费用的方式保持不变。

sentences.en: You may be wondering what will happen to the old canteen.
sentences.zh: 各位或许会好奇旧食堂将如何处理。

sentences.en: We'll still have tables and chairs in there, and pupils can eat food from the Food Hall or lunch thev've brought from home.
sentences.zh: 旧食堂内仍将保留桌椅，学生可在此食用美食厅提供的餐食或自带的午餐。

sentences.en: Eventually we may use part of the canteen for storage, but first we'll see how many pupils go in there at lunchtime.
sentences.zh: 最终我们可能会将部分旧食堂用作储藏室，但首先需观察午餐时间有多少学生进入其中。

sentences.en: Audioscripts OK, back to the serving points in the Food Hall, which will all have side dishes, desserts and drinks on sale, as well as main courses.
sentences.zh: 音频脚本 好的，回到美食厅的各个取餐点：所有取餐点均供应主菜、配菜、甜点及饮品。

sentences.en: One serving point we call World Adventures.
sentences.zh: 其中一个取餐点名为‘世界历险’。

sentences.en: This will serve a different country's cuisine each day, maybe Chinese one day and Lebanese the next.
sentences.zh: 该取餐点每日供应不同国家的菜肴，例如某天是中式，次日则是黎巴嫩风味。

sentences.en: The menus will be planned for a week at a time, so pupils will know what's going to be available the whole of that week.
sentences.zh: 菜单以周为单位制定，因此学生可提前知晓整周的供餐内容。

sentences.en: Street Life is also international, with food from three particular cultures.
sentences.zh: ‘街头生活’取餐点同样具有国际特色，主打三种特定文化的餐食。

sentences.en: We'll ask pupils to make suggestions, so perhaps sometimes there'll be food from Thailand, Ethiopia and Mexico, and then one of them will be replaced by Jamaican food for a week or two.
sentences.zh: 我们将邀请学生提出建议，因此有时可能是泰国、埃塞俄比亚和墨西哥风味，随后其中一种（如墨西哥风味）将被牙买加风味替代一至两周。

sentences.en: The Speedy Italian serving point will cater particularly for the many pupils who don't eat meat
sentences.zh: ‘快捷意大利’取餐点则特别面向众多不吃肉类或鱼类的学生。

sentences.en: or fish: they can be sure that all the food served there is suitable for them.
sentences.zh: 他们可以确信，此处供应的所有餐食均符合其饮食要求。

sentences.en: There'll be plenty of variety, so they shouldn't get bored with the food.
sentences.zh: 餐食种类丰富多样，因此他们不会对食物感到厌倦。

sentences.en: OK, that's all on the new Food Hall.
sentences.zh: 好的，关于新美食厅的情况就介绍到这里。

sentences.en: Now after-school lessons.
sentences.zh: 接下来是课后课程。

sentences.en: These are very popular with pupils, particularly swimming- in fact there's a waiting list for lessons.
sentences.zh: 这些课程深受学生欢迎，尤其是游泳课——事实上报名人数已超出容量，需排队等候。

sentences.en: Cycling is another favourite, and I'm delighted that dozens of pupils make use of the chance to learn to ride in off-road conditions.
sentences.zh: 骑行课同样广受欢迎；令人欣喜的是，数十名学生充分利用了在非公路环境下学习骑行的机会。

sentences.en: It means that more and more cycle to and from school every day.
sentences.zh: 这意味着每日骑车往返学校的学生日益增多。

sentences.en: As you know, we have a well-equipped performance centre, and we're going to start drama classes Q19IQ20 in there, too.
sentences.zh: 如各位所知，我校配备设施完善的表演中心，我们也将在此开设戏剧课程。

sentences.en: Pupils will be able to join in just for fun or work up to taking part in a play- we hope to put on at least one a year.
sentences.zh: 学生既可纯粹出于兴趣参与，也可逐步准备参演剧目——我们希望每年至少公演一部。

sentences.en: We already teach a number of pupils to use the sound and lighting systems in the centre.
sentences.zh: 目前我们已教授多名学生使用该中心的音响与灯光系统。

sentences.en: And a former pupil has given a magnificent grand piano to the school, so a few pupils will be able to learn at the school instead of going to the local college. / as many of them do at the moment.
sentences.zh: 此外，一位校友向学校捐赠了一架宏伟的三角钢琴，因此少数学生今后可在本校学习钢琴，而不必像目前这样前往本地学院。
